clips.label: Twist — original pace
clips.details: All 28 original paintings are preserved, in order. Time between paintings is half a second, with eleven RIFE frames between each pair. Both deliver 24 fps with RIFE 4.25 at scale 1. The same transition artifacts still exist; speeding up does not repair them. The players align by elapsed seconds, not by corresponding painting.

clips.label: Twist — faster
clips.details: All 28 original paintings are preserved, in order. Time between paintings is one third of a second, with seven new RIFE frames between each pair. No additional diffusion. Motion and morphing play 1.5× faster. Both deliver 24 fps with RIFE 4.25 at scale 1. The same transition artifacts still exist; speeding up does not repair them. The players align by elapsed seconds, not by corresponding painting.
